name: Diamond Confetti
description: Scattered diamonds in a mixed ink palette, overlapping in a loose confetti toss.

code.style: --rule: ( background: @doodle( :doodle { @grid: 1 / 100000px; transform: rotate(-135deg) scale(2); } background-size: 30px 30px; background-image: @doodle( @grid: 6x1 / calc(100% + 1px); @size: calc(100% - 100% / @size * (@i - 1)); position: absolute; border: 1px solid var(--color1); background: @pn( var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6), var(--color7) ); ); ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
